title: Senior Security Engineer, Red Team & Threat Intel
raw_description:
Senior Security Engineer, Red Team & Threat Intel

Team

Security

Location

Jakarta, Indonesia

Job Type

Full-time

The role at a glance

Skills you need

What we offer

Life at Grab

The role at a glance

Get to Know the Team

Join Grab's Red Team & Threat Intel team, which helps improve the security posture of Grab's products, platforms, cloud environments, AI systems, and enterprise technology across Southeast Asia.

The team partners with Security, Engineering, Infrastructure, IT, and business teams. This partnership enables the team to emulate real-world adversaries, identify the highest-impact risks, and help Grab strengthen its preventive, detective, and response capabilities. The Threat Intel function brings external incident trends, adversary behaviours, and internal improvement opportunities into Grab's security priorities. This helps the team plan intelligence-led Purple Team exercises, advise leadership, and support risk prioritisation with the Vulnerability Management team. We work with curiosity, technical depth, and responsibility, using offensive security techniques and threat intelligence to make Grab safer for our users, partners, and Grabbers.

Get to Know the Role

You will report to the Red Team & Threat Intel team leader and perform complex red team operations across cloud, CI/CD, endpoint, identity, application, and AI environments. You will design realistic attack simulations, develop offensive tooling, apply threat intelligence to Purple Team planning, and turn findings into practical improvements for engineering and security teams.

This role is based in Jakarta, Indonesia. You will help shaping Grab's Red Team and Threat Intel capabilities, and influence how we use AI and automation to scale offensive security work responsibly. If you enjoy building tools, testing assumptions, and helping defenders get sharper, we will give you the platform to make a regional impact.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

You will lead end-to-end red team operations, and intelligence-led Purple Team exercises with the Blue Team. These exercises will emulate realistic adversary behaviour across multiple environments, including cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, identity systems, endpoints, and applications.

You will develop command-and-control tooling, implants, payload delivery mechanisms, and operator workflows for authorised security exercises.

You will red team AI systems, including internal copilots, agentic workflows, AI-assisted operational tools, and MLOps environments.

You will use AI tools to improve research, automation, payload development, reporting, operational planning, and analysis of defensive coverage.

You will translate red team findings and threat intelligence into clear engineering actions. You will partner with defenders, platform teams, and the Vulnerability Management team to improve detection, response, hardening, security architecture, and risk prioritisation.

You will work with other team members on offensive security tradecraft, tool development, operational safety, documentation, and responsible execution of adversary simulations.

You will contribute to the Red Team and Threat Intel roadmap. Your contributions will involve identifying the latest attack techniques and evaluating new tooling.

You will produce Threat Intel assessments from security incidents observed in the wild or improvement opportunities identified internally. Additionally, you will advise leadership on likely impact, priority, and next actions.

Software Engineering Manager II

Team

Engineering

Location

Jakarta, Indonesia

Job Type

Full-time

The role at a glance

Skills you need

What we offer

Life at Grab

The role at a glance

Get to Know Our Team

The Fulfilment Engineering team builds the technology that connects demand with supply across Grab’s services. We solve complex marketplace problems spanning allocation, driver experience, reliability and operational efficiency, supporting millions of transactions across Southeast Asia.

We work closely with Product, Data Science, Analytics, Operations and other engineering teams to develop scalable systems that improve the experience of our driver-partners and consumers.

Get to Know the Role

You will lead a team of software engineers responsible for building and operating critical fulfilment capabilities. You will create the conditions for the team to deliver reliable outcomes, grow strong technical leaders and translate product and business priorities into an effective engineering roadmap.

As an engineering manager, you will remain technically fluent while empowering senior individual contributors to lead architecture and detailed technical decisions.

You will report to the Senior Software Engineering Manager.

At Grab, we have 5-day in office arrangement.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

Lead, coach and develop a team of software engineers, setting clear expectations and individual growth plans.

Partner with Product, Data Science, Analytics and Operations to define priorities, roadmaps and measurable outcomes.

Own planning and delivery of the team’s engineering roadmap, proactively managing dependencies and risks.

Work with senior engineers to establish sound technical direction and make appropriate architecture and engineering trade-offs.

Improve the reliability, scalability, security, observability and cost efficiency of the systems owned by the team.

Establish effective engineering practices covering design reviews, testing, deployment, incident response and continuous improvement.

Create an inclusive environment where team members have clarity, psychological safety and meaningful ownership.

Attract, assess and retain strong engineering talent while contributing to hiring and talent development across Grab.

Communicate progress, risks and decisions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

title: Searah Muara Bakau - ORF Engineering Site Representative
raw_description:
Searah is a leading independent integrated energy company in Southeast Asia, established in 2026 through the strategic partnership between Eni and PETRONAS. With a current asset base of 19 assets across Malaysia and Indonesia, Searah stands as one of the leading players in the Asia Pacific energy sector. In Indonesia, Searah Muara Bakau serves as one of Searah’s operating companies. Its operations span the exploration, development, and production of offshore natural gas resources, with a strong focus on the deepwater areas of the Kutei Basin in the Makassar Strait, contributing to energy security across Southeast Asia and the sustainable development of the communities where it operates.


We are looking for qualified personnel with high motivation, initiative, and integrity to fill the following position:


Job Title: ORF Engineering Site Representative



 

Purpose:

To serve as the owner/operator's technical and engineering authority on site at the Onshore Receiving Facility (ORF). To review and approve the specification, design, procurement, fabrication, installation, pre-commissioning, commissioning, and supply (by contractors) of all equipment, facilities, and systems in onshore receiving facilities. Ensuring that the engineering package is in conformance with schedule, project specifications, standards, codes, procedures, scope of work, design parameters, industry practices, P&IDs, line list, stress information, and vendor data.



General Accountabilities and Responsibilities:

  • Liaise with others in the design team, construction team, subcontractors, vendors, and other related stakeholders
  • Prepare the engineering package including specifications, pre-commissioning and commissioning procedures
  • Develop and review the bill of material (BOM) and Material Take-Offs (MTO) against field requirement
  • Draw and update material and stress sketches
  • Attend CAD model as required and perform 3D clash/interference checks for constructability
  • Prepare and develop 2D/3D designs and review contractor engineering deliverables
  • Internal design and subcontracted design supervision
  • Develop and review the Material selection and specification
  • Estimate cost and schedule
  • Review, process, and resolve Technical Queries (TQ), Requests for Information (RFI), and Field Change Requests (FCR) on-site to resolve technical issues promptly.
  • Conduct daily site walkdowns to ensure constructability, resolve design-to-field clashes, and verify pipe routing and equipment layouts.
  • Manage and verify site redline markups to ensure accurate final As-Built drawings (P&IDs, Isometrics, Civil/Structural/Electrical layouts).
  • Witness critical site activities including hydrotesting, pneumatic testing, loop checks, equipment alignment, bolt tensioning, and pre-start-up safety reviews (PSSR).
  • Log and manage Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), manage site punch lists (A/B/C items), and ensure resolution before facility handover.
  • Coordinate on-site equipment vendor specialists during installation, testing, and initial start-up Coordinate engineering activities for SPS and UMB work packages during FEED, detailed engineering, fabrication, and installation phases.

 


Health, Safety, Environment and Quality (HSEQ):

  • Motivate staff and colleagues to comply with HSE rules and standards.
  • Report all incidents.
  • Comply with rules and standards described in Company Policies, HSE Integrated Management System and Procedures.
  • Participate in HSE related initiatives.
raw_requirements:
Qualifications & Experience:

  • Education: Minimum of a Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical, Chemical, Civil, or Petroleum Engineering, or other equivalent subjects.
  • Experience:
    • Minimum 10 years of working experience in Onshore/ORF facilities area within Oil & Gas industry.
    • Minimum 5 years of working experience in site engineering, piping design, or construction oversight in major upstream projects
    • Have experience in Subsea interface and FPU interface or FPSO interface
  • Language: Proficient in English and Bahasa Indonesia


Required Competencies

Technical Competencies:

  • Comprehensive construction methodology for Onshore Receiving Facilities (slug catchers, pressure vessels, gas separation, gas treatment, compressor stations, flare systems, utility systems), subsea pipeline landfall interfaces, and civil/structural/E&I works. Interface with subsea facility, pipelines, and FPSO/FPU.
  • Site Material & Equipment Management, Contractor Performance Monitoring, Inspection & Test Plans (ITP), Technical Query (TQ) workflows, Construction Progress Measurement, and Management of Change (MOC).
  • Local / National Standards (Ditjen MIGAS, SKK Migas) and International Codes & Standards (ASME B31.3/B31.8, ASME Sec VIII, API 1104, API 510/570, AWS D1.1, NACE, NFPA), Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QA/QC) standards.
  • Advanced knowledge of structural erection, piping fit-up/welding, NDT interpretation, hydrotesting/pneumatic testing, heavy equipment rigging/lifting, electrical/instrumentation loop testing, pre-commissioning, and Mechanical Completion (MC) handover.
  • Look-ahead scheduling, progress tracking (S-curves), cost/change control, Punch List management, As-Built documentation, and Data Book compilation.
  • Working proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), MS Project, AutoCAD, Navisworks / 3D Model Review tools, and EDMS platforms.

 


Non-Technical Competencies:

  • Must have excellent interpersonal, writing and communication skills
  • Ability to work well within multidisciplinary teams
  • Proactive in information gathering
  • High attention to detail and orderliness

 


Working Conditions:

·         Jakarta, Indonesia

·         Possibility for business travel to other Company’s premises or field areas.

title: Head of Product (Jakarta)
raw_description:
< Kembali

Head of Product (Jakarta)

Daftar Sekarang

Jakarta, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Full-Time (WFO)

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Own and drive product strategy from

zero-to-one

, ensuring alignment with long-term product vision and company strategy, and communicate it clearly to stakeholders and users.

Lead

experimentation-driven product development

, including rapid prototyping, MVP launches, A/B testing, and iterative validation.

Define, maintain, and execute product roadmaps, ensuring milestones are delivered on time with measurable impact.

Discover user pain points through qualitative research and deep data analysis; collaborate closely with analytics teams to translate insights into actionable product decisions.

Prototype product functionality and collaborate with design/UX teams to deliver best-in-class user experiences.

Develop go-to-market strategies and partner with growth teams to drive adoption, engagement, and retention.

Apply

growth-hacking principles

to product development, focusing on scalable acquisition, activation, and monetization levers.

Be highly analytical and data-driven; define success metrics and continuously measure product performance.

Lead, coach, and develop product managers, designers, and analysts, fostering a culture of experimentation, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Proven experience working in agile development environments.

Strong communication skills in English, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders.

Exceptional problem-solving skills with structured and strategic thinking.

Strong collaboration and teamwork capabilities across cross-functional teams.

Ability to work independently in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

Kualifikasi

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Mathematics, Business, or other related fields.

8+ years of experience in Product Management, with demonstrated ownership of products from zero-to-one and scaling stages.

Strong track record in experimentation, growth initiatives, and data-led decision making.

Experience using Product Management tools (e.g. Trello, GitHub Issues, Google Drive).

Experience using Prototyping tools (e.g. Figma).

Familiarity with Data Analytics tools (e.g. Metabase, Google Analytics).

Experience in palm oil or agribusiness-related companies is preferred.

Nice to have: Background in top-tier management consulting and/or investment banking, with exposure to strategy, growth, due diligence, or complex business problem-solving.

Willing to undergo a 2-month probation period in Pekanbaru, Riau.

Tentang Perusahaan

SawitPRO is a cutting-edge green digital agritech startup located in the heart of Jakarta. Our mission is to be the best innovator that improves the lives of everyone in the palm oil industry. Through our integrated end-to-end agri-platform, we create a win-win-win scenario for people, planet, and prosperity.

We provide integrated apps that connect the supply chain stakeholders in the palm oil industry (Mills, DO Agents, Smallholders, Harvesters, Drivers, etc.). Creating a digital ecosystem that essentially boosts their productivity with effortless work documentation, affordable yet original agri-inputs, and agronomist services.

Our commitment extends beyond providing innovative solutions; we aim to nurture every aspect of Indonesia's palm oil industry. By fostering growth and sustainability, we strive to bring positive change to the lives of individuals in the palm oil sector, one at a time.

title: Software Engineer - GSI
raw_description:
Lowongan pekerjaan ini dipublikasikan melalui akun PT Global Service Indonesia. Kandidat terpilih akan menjadi karyawan PT Global Service Indonesia dengan penempatan di United Tractors Group (UT Group).

  1. Mengembangkan, memelihara, dan meningkatkan aplikasi menggunakan C# dan .NET 5 atau versi lebih baru.
  2. Mengembangkan dan mengintegrasikan API untuk mendukung kebutuhan aplikasi dan sistem.
  3. Mengelola database menggunakan Microsoft SQL Server, termasuk pembuatan query, pengolahan data, dan struktur database.
  4. Melakukan debugging, troubleshooting, serta optimalisasi performa aplikasi.
  5. Menyusun dokumentasi teknis dan diagram desain sistem.
  6. Melaksanakan pengujian sistem, termasuk System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), serta mendukung pengujian keamanan aplikasi.
  7. Mengelola kode program menggunakan version control Git.
  8. Berkolaborasi dengan tim terkait untuk memastikan aplikasi berjalan sesuai kebutuhan bisnis dan standar teknis.
raw_requirements:
1. Pendidikan minimal S1 Teknik Informatika, Ilmu Komputer, Rekayasa Perangkat Lunak, atau jurusan terkait.
  2. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 3 tahun dalam pengembangan software menggunakan C#, .NET 5 atau versi lebih baru, dan Microsoft SQL Server.
  3. Berpengalaman dalam pengembangan API, dokumentasi teknis, desain atau diagram sistem, SIT, UAT, dan penetration testing.
  4. Memahami konsep RDBMS serta SQL, termasuk Query, DML, dan DDL.
  5. Menguasai JavaScript. Pengalaman menggunakan jQuery dan Telerik Kendo UI menjadi nilai tambah.
  6. Memahami penggunaan version control, khususnya Git.
  7. Memiliki kemampuan problem-solving dan debugging yang baik.
  8. Pengalaman menggunakan Keycloak, Redis, Elasticsearch, atau Kubernetes menjadi nilai tambah.
  9. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi, interpersonal, dan presentasi yang baik.

title: TSO - Project Establishment Analyst
raw_description:
1. Mengelola pelaksanaan proyek pembangunan cabang baru, renovasi, mulai dari tahap perencanaan, pra-konstruksi, konstruksi hingga serah terima.
  2. Menganalisis kebutuhan pengembangan dan peningkatan fasilitas cabang sesuai kebutuhan operasional dan standar perusahaan.
  3. Melakukan review, evaluasi, dan koordinasi desain serta dokumen teknis proyek.
  4. Menyusun timeline proyek, memonitor progres pelaksanaan, serta memastikan proyek berjalan sesuai target waktu, kualitas, dan biaya.
  5. Berkoordinasi dengan semua stakeholder (internal, vendor, konsultan, dan kontraktor) untuk memastikan kelancaran pelaksanaan proyek.
  6. Mengidentifikasi risiko proyek, melakukan tindak lanjut, dan memberikan rekomendasi solusi yang efektif.
  7. Menyusun laporan monitoring, dokumentasi, dan presentasi progres proyek secara berkala.
  8. Mendukung pengembangan standar fasilitas dan implementasi continuous improvement dalam pelaksanaan proyek.
raw_requirements:
1.  Minimal S1 Teknik Arsitektur.
  2. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 1 tahun dalam desain arsitektur, pengembangan fasilitas, atau proyek komersial (office, retail, hotel).
  3. Mampu membaca, memahami, mengevaluasi, dan memberikan masukan terhadap gambar kerja arsitektur dan dokumen teknis proyek.
  4. Mahir menggunakan AutoCAD serta software desain lainnya seperti SketchUp, Adobe Photoshop, dan Microsoft Office terutama Excel.
  5. Memiliki kemampuan menyusun timeline proyek, menentukan prioritas pekerjaan, serta membuat monitoring dan progress report proyek.
  6. Memiliki pemahaman dasar mengenai proses pembangunan, renovasi, dan manajemen konstruksi.
  7. Mampu mengelola beberapa proyek atau pekerjaan secara bersamaan dalam lingkungan kerja yang dinamis.
  8. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi, koordinasi, dan stakeholder management yang baik.
  9. Mampu berkolaborasi secara efektif dengan tim multidisiplin, vendor, konsultan, dan kontraktor.
  10. Memiliki kemampuan analitis, kreativitas, problem solving, dan pengambilan keputusan yang baik.
  11. Proaktif, memiliki sense of ownership yang tinggi.
  12. Memiliki integritas tinggi, disiplin, dan berorientasi pada pencapaian hasil.

title: Sr DevOps Engineer - ADMO
raw_description:
1. Menjembatani kesenjangan antara Tim Core Infrastructure, Security, QA, dan Developer.
  2. Menguasai Ketersediaan dan Performa aplikasi dan infrastrukturnya secara menyeluruh
  3. Menyediakan dukungan infrastruktur & aplikasi 24X7 infra & app support
  4. Membuat, mengelola, dan memelihara seluruh infrastruktur menggunakan IaC.
  5. Melakukan onboarding aplikasi baru dengan proses peninjauan kesiapan produksi.
  6. Bekerja sama dengan Tim Developer untuk memiliki pemahaman mendalam tentang arsitektur aplikasi dan hambatannya.
  7. Mengidentifikasi kesenjangan observabilitas dalam aplikasi & infrastruktur dan bekerja sama dengan pemangku kepentingan untuk memperbaikinya dengan memanfaatkan perangkat yang tepat.
  8. Mengelola pemadaman dan melakukan RCA terperinci dengan pengembang serta mengidentifikasi cara untuk menghindari situasi tersebut.
  9. Mengotomatiskan kerja keras dan pekerjaan berulang.
raw_requirements:
1. Gelar Sarjana dari jurusan Teknik Informatika/Sistem Informasi/Teknik Komputer/Manajemen Informatika atau bidang terkait dari universitas terkemuka dengan IPK minimal 3,00.
  2. Minimal 6 tahun pengalaman kerja dalam mengelola high traffic site, layanan mikro berskala besar, dan infrastruktur dengan keterampilan pemecahan masalah yang sangat baik. 
  3. Pengalaman dalam pemecahan masalah, pengelolaan, dan penerapan lingkungan terkontainerisasi menggunakan Docker/containerd. 
  4. Harus memiliki 5 tahun pengalaman kerja di lingkungan Kubernetes/Openshift. 
  5. Harus memiliki 2-3 tahun pengalaman bekerja dengan diagram helm. 
  6. Berpengalaman dengan administrasi Linux dan pemahaman yang baik tentang berbagai subsistem kernel Linux (memori, penyimpanan, jaringan, dll.). 
  7. Berpengalaman dalam DNS, TCP/IP, UDP, Routing, dan Load Balancing. 
  8. Berpengalaman dengan alat pemantauan dan pencatatan (misalnya, NewRelic, DataDog, Prometheus, Grafana, tumpukan ELK). 
  9. Keahlian dalam GitOps, alat Infrastruktur sebagai Kode seperti Terraform, dll. 
  10. Keahlian dalam AWS Cloud dan/atau solusi Infrastruktur Cloud relevan lainnya. 
  11. Pengalaman dalam membangun jalur CI/CD dengan alat seperti Jenkins, GitLab, dll. 
  12. Pengalaman dengan beberapa penyimpanan data merupakan nilai tambah (Kafka/RabbitMQ, Redis, Elasticsearch). 
  13. Wajib menguasai salah satu bahasa skrip DevOps (Bash / Python / Go). 
  14. Semangat kolaboratif dengan kemampuan bekerja lintas disiplin untuk memengaruhi, belajar, dan memberikan hasil. 
  15. Pemahaman mendalam tentang ilmu komputer, pengembangan perangkat lunak, dan prinsip-prinsip jaringan

title: Head of ODU Product Pricing & Revenue
raw_description:
REQUIREMENTS

 

Education: Bachelor’s degree in economics, finance, business or engineering.

Experience: Seven to ten years in telco, broadband or subscription pricing, revenue management or commercial finance, with experience leading people or commercial workstreams.

Financial Modelling: Advanced Excel skills covering pricing, unit economics, forecasts, business cases and sensitivity analysis.

Business Acumen: Ability to balance customer affordability, growth, margin and network capacity using measurable commercial decisions.

Leadership and Communication: Ability to coach officers, influence cross-functional stakeholders and defend recommendations to Finance and senior leadership.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Master’s degree in a relevant discipline.
  • Experience with FWA or fixed broadband pricing, device financing and recurring subscription economics.
  • Working knowledge of SQL or Power BI and billing or revenue assurance processes.

Job Description

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Pricing Strategy and Portfolio Economics

  • Develop monthly and advance-payment plans, installation fees, device pricing and installment options in coordination with Product Development.
  • Develop pricing for additional data and service upgrades with the Network team; recommend price changes through the Head of Product FWA, Finance and the pricing approval forum.

2. Promotion Governance and Business Cases

  • Evaluate acquisition, retention and renewal programmes through additional profit contribution, subsidy, payback and return assessments before and after launch.
  • Approve promotions only within the delegated mandate and approved budget; escalate exceptions and stop programmes that do not meet agreed economics.

3. Revenue Planning and Performance

  • Own FWA revenue forecasts, average revenue per customer plans and gap-closing actions against annual business targets; review acquisition, recurring and additional service revenue weekly.
  • Maintain the FWA business case with Finance for annual planning and the long-term business plan, including sensitivity analysis and monthly variance explanations.

4. Revenue Assurance and Channel Economics

  • Coordinate investigation and closure of price configuration errors, unauthorised discounts, promotion abuse and unpaid service entitlements.
  • Assess device costs, partner discounts, channel margins and commissions with Sales Planning and channel owners to maintain affordable acquisition costs.

5. Acquisition and Base Leadership

  • Set priorities, budgets and commercial guidelines for the two officers covering acquisition and customer base management.
  • Review acquisition quality, active customer growth, customer attrition, renewal and programme returns; coach the team and align corrective actions with Network, customer lifecycle management teams and Regional teams.

6. Cross Functional and Pricing Governance

  • Coordinate FWA pricing with Pricing and Marketing teams to avoid conflicts with other company offers; escalate cross-portfolio proposals for approval.
  • Present revenue outlook, commercial risks and pricing recommendations to senior management; track competitor pricing and recommend evidence-based responses.

title: Senior Software Engineer (English), Python and JavaScript
raw_description: The work Analyze and triage issues across open-source repositories. Configure development environments and Dockerize repositories for reliable local execution. Run, modify, debug, and test real-world software projects locally. Evaluate unit-test coverage, reliability, and overall test quality. Assess large language model performance on bug-fixing and software engineering tasks. Identify challenging repositories and issues for AI evaluation benchmarks. Help design evaluation scenarios with researchers and engineers. Review code, provide technical guidance, and coordinate small teams when required. What it takes The role requires at least 5 years of professional software engineering experience. Strong proficiency in Python and JavaScript, with practical experience using Git and Docker. Understanding of software development pipelines and continuous integration workflows. Ability to navigate, modify, run, and test complex codebases locally. Strong debugging, code review, and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently and communicate technical findings clearly. Fluency in English. Open worldwide. Plan for 20+ hours per week. How it works Apply on OpenTrain with your resume, then complete the application on the hiring site. About AI training work OpenTrain is a platform where people find AI training and data-labeling work, build a profile, and apply to projects. AI training uses human input to improve systems such as language models, and experienced software engineers help evaluate whether those systems can handle real coding tasks accurately. This role focuses on the software engineering side of AI training: preparing real codebases, testing model-generated solutions, and judging the quality of technical results.

Professional fluency in English is required. Expert-level proficiency in JavaScript, Java, and Python is required. You need experience architecting and deploying scalable software systems, plus strong knowledge of software design principles, algorithms, and data structures. Strong problem-solving, communication, and attention-to-detail skills are required, along with experience working productively with remote or distributed teams. You should be able to lead technical discussions and provide constructive peer feedback. Experience mentoring and guiding software engineering teams, cloud-based architectures or distributed systems, and CI/CD pipelines or DevOps practices is helpful. Passing it is how you qualify for paid tasks, so take it soon after you are invited. The hiring platform's application for this job asks for your resume, your LinkedIn profile, your phone number, your location and answers to 3 screening questions. About AI training work AI training work is the human work behind systems that learn from examples, including software and code examples. Experienced contributors are needed to create, review, and improve technical work so AI systems can produce more useful and reliable results. OpenTrain helps people find these projects, build a profile, and apply through one account.

Preferred: A background in linguistics, language studies, or localization, plus familiarity with annotation tools and platforms. Life at Grab

Get to Know the Team

Grabber Technology Solutions (GTS) aims to be a technology leader that provides predictive and seamless experiences to all Grab employees (Grabbers). We are a diverse team of technology practitioners looking to out-serve Grabbers with positive, personalised IT experiences. We are looking for individuals with similar customer-centric and innovative values to join our growing team

The Identity Management team is responsible for managing identities and privileged access across Grab's enterprise infrastructure. The team maintains core identity and access solutions, helping to secure Grab's privileged access landscape.

Get to Know the Role

In this position, you'll be supporting Grab's enterprise infrastructure with an emphasis on Identity and Privileged Access Management. The Identity Management team at Grab is committed to overseeing access to Grab's enterprise applications and safeguarding access to vital systems and sensitive data. Our mission is “Empowering Grabbers with secure, seamless access to systems and data; simplifying productivity and creating time for what matters”.

Our responsibilities include ongoing monitoring, auditing, and regular reviews to uphold a robust access control environment. A mindset geared towards optimisation and automation is essential, along with the ability to work independently and foster relationships with stakeholders throughout Grab. least privilege and secure privileged access

.

Integration, Automation & Governance

title: Searah Muara Bakau - Operations Specialist
raw_description:
﻿Searah is a leading independent integrated energy company in Southeast Asia, established in 2026 through the strategic partnership between Eni and PETRONAS. With a current asset base of 19 assets across Malaysia and Indonesia, Searah stands as one of the leading players in the Asia Pacific energy sector. In Indonesia, Searah Muara Bakau serves as one of Searah’s operating companies. Its operations span the exploration, development, and production of offshore natural gas resources, with a strong focus on the deepwater areas of the Kutei Basin in the Makassar Strait, contributing to energy security across Southeast Asia and the sustainable development of the communities where it operates.


We are looking for qualified personnel with high motivation, initiative, and integrity to fill the following position:


Job Title: Operations Specialist 


Purpose:

The Operation Specialist is responsible for ensuring the reliable operation and maintenance of all facility equipment. This includes optimizing facility performance and troubleshooting various processing systems such as pumps, compressors, generators, processing units, and production chemicals. The role also plays a key part in developing and implementing initiatives to enhance processing facility performance.

The Operation Specialist ensures the prompt, safe, and environmentally responsible execution of all operational activities. The position is accountable for maintaining safe operations, maximizing equipment uptime and field production efficiency, and minimizing total operating costs—including LPO, production downtime, spare parts usage, and overall resource management.

The role is expected to meet or exceed daily production targets while ensuring full compliance with company guidelines, regulatory requirements, and Safe Operating Principles, ultimately delivering maximum value to stakeholders without compromise.

 

General Accountabilities and Responsibilities:

  • Reporting to the Operation & Maintenance Superintendent (O&M Supt), the Operation Specialist is responsible for coordinating process support to optimize the operation of offshore facilities. All activities must be conducted safely, maximizing field production efficiency while minimizing total operating costs—including LPO, production downtime, spare parts usage, and overall resource management. The role is expected to meet or exceed daily production targets while ensuring full compliance with company guidelines and legal requirements.
  • Manage respective people and organization with relevant administration and report, also managing HSE function in the respective department.
  • Coordinate development project activities relevant to the offshore equipment with focus on Pre-Operations Works and establish Operations requirements during detail engineering, construction, commissioning, start up phases of new oil/gas production facilities, ensuring that commissioning phase and startup operations are conducted in safe, effective and efficiently manner with meeting the company target and to the satisfaction of all parties.  
  • Support all operation readiness activities and assurance review from initial concept through to project sanction, and possibly through project execution, ensuring that the design meets project objectives for cost, schedule, safety and environmental impact. Assure all operation aspects and risk opportunities to optimize the construction activities in the field, have been address and mitigate the risk.


 

Health, Safety, Environment and Quality (HSEQ):

  • Comply with rules and standards described in Company Policies, HSE Integrated Management System and Procedures
  • Report all incidents
  • Motivate staff and colleagues to comply with HSE rules and standards
  • Participate in HSE related initiatives
raw_requirements:
Qualifications & Experience:

  • Education: Bachelor degree in Engineering in major of Chemical, Petroleum, Industrial, Mechanical or Electrical engineering.
  • Professional Qualifications:
    • Minimum 5 years of experience in the Oil & Gas industry in offshore facilities 
    • Minimum 5 years of experience in offshore commissioning and startup of oil/ gas field development projects 
    • Previous Upstream Engineering Floating Production Unit, RSI –SPS, FPU commissioning experience is preferred    
    • Experienced in operation for offshore gas facilities is preferred
    • Familiar with Microsoft Office
  • Training, Certification and Courses: BNSP-certified
  • Language: Fluent in English and Bahasa Indonesia


Required Competencies

Non-Technical Competencies:

  • Negotiation Skill
  • Legal analysis
  • Problem solving
  • Interpersonal and communication
  • Confidence
  • Teamwork

 

Working Conditions:

  • Offshore / FPSO, rotational base.

title: bp - Kerja Praktek - Tangguh Future - Indonesia
raw_description:
We will not proceed any application from this job portal, please copy & paste bp's job link here:

https://bpinternational.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com/bpEarlyCareers/job/Indonesia---Jakarta/Kerja-Praktek-Internship---Tangguh-Future---Indonesia_RQ117045 


About bp

As a leading global energy company with a presence in 61 countries, bp’s purpose is to deliver energy to the world, today and tomorrow. We are one of only a few companies that can deliver energy – at scale – to countries and millions of customers every day. With more than 100 years of experience, we bring together technology, innovation and deep expertise that keeps communities moving – and we’re still evolving.


About early careers

Early careers opportunities

Your talent. Your skills. Your big ideas (and even bigger dreams). We know you have a lot to give. So we’ll make sure you get a lot in return. From next-level experiences to global impact. From inspiring teammates to exceptional support – we offer graduate and internship roles across multiple areas


Our internships

Make an impact on cutting-edge projects. Help find solutions to complex challenges. Be part of a company that invests in you and your growth. You can do it all as an intern at bp. Our 12-week programme gives you the opportunity to build your technical knowledge, develop key skills and learn more about life at bp. You'll be part of one team throughout your internship, supported by a dedicated line manager and buddy. There’ll be opportunities to connect with other interns, take part in training and grow your network across the business


Why join us?

You can make a real impact early in your bp career, contributing to large, complex projects on a global scale. There are many opportunities to learn here, whether through training, mentoring and stretch assignments or sharing knowledge with expert colleagues.

The diversity of our teams and business areas gives the option to develop your career in many different ways. We have a truly caring company culture, where your growth and wellbeing are supported every step of the way.


About the programme 

Kerja Praktek is an early career programme designed for upcoming 6th semester or 3rd-year university students to help students apply their academic knowledge in real-world settings and develop valuable career skills, while also fulfilling their academic credit requirements.


Intern – tangguh future

Tangguh Futures is a strategic development project designed to sustain the long-term supply of natural gas to the Tangguh LNG facilities in Papua Barat. It brings together a portfolio of offshore and onshore developments to support production from existing fields and maintain reliable LNG operations.

The project covers the integrated development of gas resources, wells, subsea and offshore facilities, pipelines, and supporting onshore infrastructure. Its delivery requires close coordination across subsurface, engineering, project management, commercial, regulatory, environmental, and social disciplines to develop a safe, competitive, and technically robust solution.

Beyond securing future energy supply, Tangguh Futures supports long-term value creation for bp, its partners, Indonesia, and local communities. The project therefore places strong emphasis on operational safety, cost efficiency, environmental and social responsibility, stakeholder engagement, and sustainable development throughout its planning and execution.

 

Roles and responsibilities        

Kerja Praktek:

·       Assist with day-to-day operations and projects within the assigned department

·       Participate in team meetings and contribute ideas

·       Conduct research and prepare reports or presentations

·       Support administrative tasks and documentation

·       Learn and apply relevant tools and technologies


The precise nature of your role and task will be determined by your skills as well as the needs of the business but your responsibilities include:      

  • Working on task and supporting your squad to find the best solutions     

  • Helping to maintain performance within your squad and for bp as a company     

  • Building relationships within bp, collaborating across functions and squads to deliver excellence     

  • Demonstrating agility, initiative and dedication through the bp “Who we are”.    

During your programme you’ll get continuous feedback and guidance on how to plan and deliver your assigned project or task, along with advice on what to look for and who to talk to. You’ll also be encouraged, individually and together with your Intern peer group, to find out as much as possible about other teams, disciplines and operations to broaden your understanding of the bp business. And successful interns may get an opportunity to rejoin as a graduate the following year.
raw_requirements:
To be eligible for the internship programme you are:   

  • Be undertaking a relevant Bachelors (S1) or Masters (S2) in Civil Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Mining Engineering, Energy Engineering.

  • Have a willingness to learn, a passion to excel and deliver results

  • Graduation criteria for eligibility for internship: graduating by August or November 2028 or will be penultimate year student (3rd year/ 6th semester) in January 2027.

  • Internship is part of your academic requirements or it can be converted as academic credits.

  • Available to participate for the full internship period from June-August 2027

 

 

Location    

You will be based in our Jakarta office.    

 

Document to submit along with your application 

 - Resume/CV 

- Academic Transcript 

- (Only when you get selected) University endorsement letter: This letter must be printed on your university’s official letterhead, and it should confirm that the internship is a mandatory part of your academic program or bp internship can be considered as academic credit

 

You can combine all documents into one file. If you accidentally only upload 1 document. Please do not withdraw your application if you have any missing documents and send us email for the remaining documents through the link contact us below or email enquiryearlycareers@bp.com

Incomplete supporting documents will not be processed further.

 

Applications close on 30 November 2026. 

Please note the following when applying:

  • You can only apply to 1 bp early careers opportunity globally per academic year – within this time, we will only process the first application you make, and you’ll be withdrawn from any subsequent applications.  

  • Please note that vacancies are filled on an ongoing basis after opening and we may close applications before any stated deadline. Therefore, we highly recommend you submit your application as early as possible to be considered for the opportunity of your choice.

title: bp - Graduate - Wells - Indonesia
raw_description:
We will not proceed any application from this job portal, please copy & paste bp's job link here:

https://bpinternational.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com/bpEarlyCareers/job/Indonesia---Jakarta/Summer-Internship---Wells---Indonesia_RQ116665 

About bp 

bp operates at the heart of the global energy system, helping countries meet their energy needs and serving millions of customers every day. With world-class assets, technology, trading capability and partnerships, we deliver energy at scale today while investing with discipline in the energy transition. 


About early careers  

Early careers opportunities  

Your talent. Your skills. Your big ideas (and even bigger dreams). We know you have a lot to give.  So, we’ll make sure you get a lot in return. From next-level experiences to global impact. From inspiring teammates to exceptional support – we offer graduate and internship roles across multiple areas. 


Our One Wells early careers program

Big challenges. Steep learning curves. Career-defining experiences. Through the One Wells early careers program,

you'll gain hands-on experience across the well lifecycle and help deliver energy safely.

Why work in One Wells at bp?

• Experience different areas of wells through structured rotations and projects.

• Build technical and professional skills that will shape your future career.

• Learn from experienced wells professionals and dedicated mentors.

• Join a global network built on collaboration and a safety-first culture.

As part of the One Wells program, you’ll complete two or three rotations designed to give you breadth of experience across your chosen business area while also supporting you to build technical depth. From drilling and completions to interventions and operations – this program gives you to experience and exposure to build the technical expertise needed for a successful career.

Join us and you’ll get the support of a structured technical pathway and our training program, designed to help you grow both professionally and personally. In return, you'll bring your ideas, curiosity and ambition to real

business challenges. Along the way, you'll be part of a supportive bp early careers community that will help you grow, succeed and make a meaningful impact from day one.


Wells

As a Wells Graduate Engineer, you’ll begin your career by embarking on our world-class graduate programme. This programme is designed to help you become familiar with a wide range of bp activities and learn the basic skills of a Wells Engineer. You’ll be expected to spend your first year working offshore as a Well Site Engineer, which is a key member of our operational rig teams. This role will support your teams’ objectives and build your understanding how Wells are constructed.


You’ll then join one of our onshore teams where you’ll specialise in either Drilling, Completions, Interventions, Integrity, or Subsea disciplines. With support from your team and mentors, you will develop the engineering knowledge you need to design, build, operate and maintain the Wells of the future.


You will receive comprehensive on the job learning under the guidance of a Senior Engineer, but it is expected that you will also build your own knowledge through experience. You will deliver projects which support your teams’ objectives and gain opportunities to stretch your knowledge by supporting other disciplines. There will be opportunities to move between Wells disciplines to broaden your experience.


As a Well Engineer, you have the opportunity work in a multidisciplinary team to deliver the project objectives. You will be working alongside Subsurface, Operations, Supply Chain and Finance amongst others. As a Wells Engineer, you are part of the team who deliver safe and resilient hydrocarbons as part of BPs wider strategy.


Roles and responsibilities ​     
Roles and responsibilities ​

Your part in this could be any of the following:

  • Assessing future exploration and development prospects for cost and technical feasibility.

  • Designing new wells, coordinating a rig team and a wide range of contractors to build them.

  • Recommending how to re-use or repair existing wells to extend their useful production life.

  • Specifying and ordering the materials and services needed for well construction and maintenance.

  • Analysing performance and recommending changes to improve economic returns.

  • Seeking out and applying new techniques or technologies to solve technical well problems.

  • Evaluating the integrity of existing wells, maintaining, or repairing them to ensure they remain safe.

  • Decommissioning wells which have reached the end of their life.

  • Communicating with our external operating partners and government agencies.


Displaying bp’s core beliefs, you’ll become part of an organisation committed to a diverse, energetic, and inclusive culture that thrives on open, transparent, and constructive feedback.

You’ll have a good understanding of scientific principles from your studies. In addition to your technical ability, you need to be dedicated, enthusiastic, committed individuals with great organisational skills. From the beginning you’ll be expected to act as a leader, prepared to speak up, and demonstrate a deep commitment to maintaining safety.
raw_requirements:
To be eligible to apply to the internship positions, you are:  

  • Be undertaking a relevant Bachelors (S1) or Masters (S2) or PhD (S3) degree in related roles, such as petroleum engineering, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, industrial engineering, metallurgy engineering, material engineering, electrical engineering

  • Have a willingness to learn, a passion to excel and deliver results

  • Graduation criteria for eligibility for internship:

- Graduating by August or October 2027 or will be final year student (4th year/ 8th semester) in January 2027

- Fresh Graduates

- Professional with maximum 2 years of working experience

 

Location

You will be based in our Jakarta office   

 

Document to submit along with your application 

- Resume/CV 

- Academic Transcript 

 

 You can combine all documents into one file. If you accidentally only upload 1 document, please do not withdraw your application and send us email for the remaining documents through the link contact us below. 

Applications close on 30 November 2026.  


Please note the following when applying:

  • You can only apply to 1 bp early careers opportunity globally per academic year – within this time, we will only process the first application you make, and you’ll be withdrawn from any subsequent applications.  

  • Please note that vacancies are filled on an ongoing basis after opening and we may close applications before any stated deadline. Therefore, we highly recommend you submit your application as early as possible to be considered for the opportunity of your choice.

title: Prime Natuna EP - Sr. Naval Architect
raw_description:
Responsible for Designing Vessels for Floating Infrastructure Project and ensure its safe and optimum project delivery as well as reliable operation. 

Areas of Accountability, Responsibility and Competence:

  • ​​Plan the whole build process of a Vessel, Managing everything From Concept through to Delivery of the Final Product 
  • ​Undertaking the Design, from Concept through FEED to Detailed Design of Turret and spread-moored systems for Offshore Structures. 
  • ​Assess Project Requirements and Research Feasibility 
  • ​Designing and Analysing Subsea Flexibles (Risers, Umbilicals and Power Cables) for Deep and Shallow Water Offshore Structures. 
  • ​Provide Engineering Solutions, Technical and Commercial Guidance, Support and Project Management for Concept Design Studies, New Vessel Constructions, Refits and Conversions 
  • ​Conduct a Risk Analysis of Ships and Marine Structures, using the Regulations of Classification Societies and Intergovernmental Organisations such as the International Maritime Organisation (IMO), to assess aspects of design such as Strength, Stability and Lifesaving 
  • ​Ensure Projects are completed in accordance with Industry Standards 
  • ​Provide on-Board Safety Training for Crews (for Naval Architects with Seafaring experience). 
  • ​Performing Intact and Damaged Stability Calculations for Floating Units. 
  • ​Perform Hydrodynamic Analyses for Floating Units for Oil & Gas and Renewable Industries. 
  • ​Writing and Checking Technical Reports 
  • ​Ensure Construction, Pre-Commissioning, and Start-up Activities for Floating Infrastructure Project are delivered safely as per Company requirement. 
  • Develop Naval Architecture report for Management in a timely manner.
raw_requirements:
Qualification / Experience:

• Bachelor’s degree in Naval Architecture, Marine Engineering, or other relevant Engineering discipline.

• Minimum 15 years of Experience in Naval Architecture Engineering within the Oil & Gas industry, with strong exposure to Offshore Floating Infrastructure Projects, preferably Covering Concept, FEED, Detailed Engineering, and Project Execution Phases.

• Proven Experience in Engineering and Design of Offshore Floating Facilities, including FPSO or equivalent Floating Production Units, Covering Vessel/Hull Design, Stability, Hydrodynamics, and Marine Systems.

• Experience in Engineering of Mooring and associated Subsea Interface Systems, including Turret/Spread Mooring and Dynamic Analysis of Risers, Umbilicals, and Power Cables.

• Experience in New-Build, Conversion, Refit, or Modification of Floating Facilities, including Engineering Support through Construction, Pre-Commissioning, and Start-Up Activities.

• Fluent in English, both written and spoken, with proficiency in relevant Naval Architecture, Hydrodynamic, Mooring, Riser Analysis, and Stability Software.

Special Skills:

'• In-depth expertise in Naval Architecture Engineering and Design for Offshore Floating Facilities, including Hull Configuration, Vessel Arrangement, Stability, Hydrodynamics, Structural Integrity, and Marine System requirements.

• Strong capability in intact and damage stability assessment and Hydrodynamic Analysis for Floating Units, including evaluation of Vessel Performance under Operating and Environmental conditions.

• Strong Technical Knowledge of station-keeping and Mooring Systems, including Turret and Spread-Moored Configurations, with capability to assess their integration with Hull and Floating Facility Design.

• Good understanding of Riser, Umbilical, and Subsea Flexible Dynamic Interfaces, including their Interaction with Vessel Motions, Mooring Systems, and Floating Facility configuration.

• Comprehensive knowledge of applicable Classification Society rules, IMO requirements, and Offshore Industry codes and standards, with proficiency in relevant Hydrodynamic, Mooring, Riser Dynamic Analysis, and Stability Software.

title: Prime Natuna EP - Subsea Work Package Project Manager
raw_description:
Responsible for Delivering, Leading and Managing the Subsea Work Package for Subsea Well Development from Pre-FEED through FEED and subsequent EPCI phases. The role provides dedicated Leadership for the Development of Technical requirements, Design Basis, Contractor Engineering Management, Technical Assurance, and Delivery of Subsea Production Systems, Wells Interfaces, Umbilicals, Risers, Flowlines and associated integration with Fixed Infrastructure and Floating Facilities. The role also supports the Tuna Project as and when required, while ensuring Subsea Development activities are Delivered Safely, Efficiently and in line with approved Scope, Schedule, Budget, Quality and Regulatory Commitments.

This position oversees all Subsea works at Tuna Block and Natuna Block.
raw_requirements:
Qualification / Work Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering.
  • Minimum 15 years of Experience in the Upstream Oil and Gas Industry, with Strong Exposure to Electrohydraulic Subsea Well Development, preferably covering FEED and EPCI phases in a Leading or Managerial role.
  • Strong Leadership and Stakeholder Management Skills, with the ability to Lead Multidisciplinary teams and Coordinate Interfaces across various Functions.
  • Proven experience across the Subsea Project Lifecycle, including Engineering, Procurement, Manufacturing/Fabrication, Construction, Installation, Pre-commissioning, Commissioning and Start-up.
  • Experience in Contractor Engineering Management and Technical Assurance, including Review and Approval of Engineering Deliverables, rRsolution of Technical Queries and Monitoring of Contractor Performance.
  • Demonstrated Capability in Managing Critical Interfaces among Subsea Production Systems, Wells, Umbilicals, Risers, Flowlines, Fixed Infrastructure and Floating Facilities.

 

Special Skills / Knowledge:

  • Familiar with Project Planning and Control, Contract and Risk Management.
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken, with Proficiency in MS Office and relevant Project Management Tools/Software.
  • In-depth Knowledge and Experience in Subsea Well Development from Conceptual Study until Commissioning and Start-up.
  • Broad and Extensive Knowledge of Components, Hardware, Infrastructures and Facilities required for Subsea Well Development.
  • Comprehensive understanding on the Modifications required at the Existing Facilities to support Subsea Development.
  • Able to implement and embed applicable Subsea Engineering Codes, Standards and specifications to effect Project Delivery.
  • Good Knowledge of Regulatory Framework and relevant Legislation.
  • Having latest Knowledge of Industry and Technology Development associated with Subsea Well Development.

title: Searah Muara Bakau - Subsea Control Intern
raw_description:
Searah is a leading independent integrated energy company in Southeast Asia, established in 2026 through the strategic partnership between Eni and PETRONAS. With a current asset base of 19 assets across Malaysia and Indonesia, Searah stands as one of the leading players in the Asia Pacific energy sector. In Indonesia, Searah Muara Bakau serves as one of Searah’s operating companies. Its operations span the exploration, development, and production of offshore natural gas resources, with a strong focus on the deepwater areas of the Kutei Basin in the Makassar Strait, contributing to energy security across Southeast Asia and the sustainable development of the communities where it operates.


Department: Operations – Asset Integrity & Subsea Operations

Program Duration: 6 months

Placement: Searah Muara Bakau Jakarta Office – Pondok Indah Office Tower 3 (Jl. Sultan Iskandar Muda, Kav. V-TA, Jakarta

Activities:

  • Support in managing subsea control system (and interfacing with relevant topside control systems) condition monitoring, troubleshooting and optimization/performance analysis in order to maximise asset value, including:
    • Specifying test methods for control systems, interpreting test results and performing troubleshooting
    • Identifying risks and opportunities and developing technical solutions to improve the performance of control systems
  • Support in managing subsea control capital spare & inventory include preservation, storage & monitoring (PSM) requirements.
  • Support in obsolescence management, obsolescence monitoring & resolution using obsolescence IT tool for subsea control system.
  • Support in subsea operation readiness interface for new subsea field tie-in.
  • Support in subsea cybersecurity management.
  • Support subsea completion & well integrity management

• Minimum holds Bachelor’s Degree (S-1), Graduate from Instrumentation, Control System, Automation, Engineering, Physics, Electrical, or Mechanical Engineering
  • Minimum GPA 3.25 out of 4.00
  • Fresh graduate maximum 1 (one) year from graduation as indicated in the Academic Certificate or Letter of Graduation (Surat Keterangan Lulus)
  • Fluent in English and Bahasa Indonesia (written and spoken)

title: Prime Natuna EP - Geologist
raw_description:
Focused on field development and production Geology. This position will play a key role in maximizing hydrocarbon recovery from our new field development assets, working under the guidance of Senior Geoscientists, and utilize Geomodelling software to build and update static models, correlate wells, and support Field Development Plans. 

Areas of Accountability, Responsibility and Competence:

·     Support the development and continuous updating of 3D static geological models for active and new development fields.

·     Perform detailed well-to-well correlation, well log analysis, and core/cuttings integration to refine reservoir zonation and identify bypassed pay or infill drilling opportunities.

·     Assist in the preparation of subsurface deliverables for Subsurface Evaluation Reports (SER), Field Development Plans (FDP), resource evaluations, and well proposals.

·     Monitor production data and work closely with Reservoir Engineers and Production Technologists to update geological models and explain production anomalies.

·     Support post-drill well evaluations and end-of-well reports, ensuring new geological data is rapidly integrated into existing subsurface workflows.

·     Assist in preparing subsurface data, maps, and reports in compliance with local regulatory requirements.

·     Participate in multidisciplinary team meetings, contributing geological insights to well planning and production optimization discussions.
raw_requirements:
Qualification / Work Experience:

·   Education: Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.) or Master of Science (M.Sc.) in Geology, Petroleum Geology, Geosciences, or a closely related discipline

·   Experience: Fresh graduate or up to 1 year of experience in Geoscience. (Fresh Graduates with Strong Academic Projects, Internships, or Thesis work related to development Geology, Reservoir characterization, or Natuna Basin are highly encouraged to apply).

·   Software Skills: Foundational knowledge or academic exposure to Petrel software. Proficiency in Microsoft 365 for Data Analysis and Technical Presentations.

· Technical Knowledge: Solid understanding of Development Geology Principles, Sedimentology, Stratigraphy, Structural Geology, and basic Reservoir Engineering Concepts.

title: PRIME Natuna EP - FPSO ENGINEERING & CONSTRUCTION MANAGER (FPSO Delivery Manager)
raw_description:
Responsible for delivering, leading and managing the Floating Infrastructure element of the development project. This position has delegated accountability and the responsibility to:

  • Deliver, lead and manage the Floating Infrastructure elements of development projects. 
  • Delivery of inputs from contributory functions and disciplines from project select gate to commencement of the production phase,
  • Ensuring that Floating Infrastructure elements of development projects are delivered in a safe, quality and environmentally conscious manner in line with budget and schedule commitments and other agreed project KPIs per phase of each project, all whilst ensuring maximum value is obtained for key Stakeholders.

Whilst the initial role is specific to the Tuna PSC asset, the role shall also support the long-term strategic view of potential future developments within the Business Unit portfolio, additionally supporting the Exploration function in the Identify Phase, proposing, costing, scheduling and evaluating development options, whilst offering innovative solutions to development challenges. 

This position is critically required at the earliest stage to ensure effective Leadership and Coordination of the upcoming FPSO FEED Tender process.

raw_description:
< Kembali

Product Software Quality (Pekanbaru)

Daftar Sekarang

Pekanbaru, Pekanbaru City, Riau, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Full-Time (WFO)

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Create test plan and test case in detail, comprehensive and well structured.

Plan and Coordinate testing execution.

Create testing and bug fixing documentation.

Execute script testing and application testing.

Monitoring debugging process and bug fixing.

Doing investigation and provide solution on the issue and bug found during testing.

Tracking of the quality assurance metric e.g. open defect counts.

Experience working in a team with agile development environment.

Good communication skills in English.

Strong problem-solving.

Collaboration & Teamwork.

Able to work independently.

Kualifikasi

Bachelor’s degree, majoring in Computer Science, Information Technology or other related fields.

3-4 years of experience in software testing.

Experience in testing mobile, web, and API for both manual and automation.

Experience in Automation Testing Tools (e.g: Robotframework, Appium, Selenium).

Experience in Load Testing Tools (e.g: JMeter).

Experience in Penetration Testing Tools.

Experience in Behavior Driven Development & Tools (e.g: Cucumber with Gherkin).

SawitPRO is a cutting-edge green digital agritech startup located in the heart of Jakarta. Our mission is to be the best innovator that improves the lives of everyone in the palm oil industry. Through our integrated end-to-end agri-platform, we create a win-win-win scenario for people, planet, and prosperity.

We provide integrated apps that connect the supply chain stakeholders in the palm oil industry (Mills, DO Agents, Smallholders, Harvesters, Drivers, etc.). Creating a digital ecosystem that essentially boosts their productivity with effortless work documentation, affordable yet original agri-inputs, and agronomist services.

Our commitment extends beyond providing innovative solutions; we aim to nurture every aspect of Indonesia's palm oil industry. By fostering growth and sustainability, we strive to bring positive change to the lives of individuals in the palm oil sector, one at a time.

title: Accounting Analyst - GF
raw_description:
1. Melakukan pencatatan dan memastikan transaksi keuangan sesuai dengan standar akuntansi dan kebijakan perusahaan.
  2. Menjalankan proses month-end dan year-end closing, termasuk jurnal, accrual, dan adjustment.
  3. Melakukan rekonsiliasi akun, termasuk bank, AR, AP, dan akun terkait lainnya, serta menindaklanjuti selisih yang ditemukan.
  4. Melakukan review dan analisis General Ledger (GL) untuk mengidentifikasi ketidaksesuaian dan transaksi yang memerlukan tindak lanjut.
  5. Memantau dan merekonsiliasi AR, AP, prepaid expense, accrued expense, serta akun terkait lainnya.
  6. Melakukan pencatatan dan rekonsiliasi aset tetap, termasuk depreciation, movement, impairment, dan disposal.
  7. Menyiapkan schedule dan supporting data untuk kebutuhan financial reporting, termasuk Neraca, Laba Rugi, dan Arus Kas.
  8. Memastikan accounting treatment atas transaksi dan kejadian tertentu sesuai dengan standar akuntansi yang berlaku.
  9. Mendukung proses audit dan internal control dengan menyiapkan data, dokumen, dan rekonsiliasi yang diperlukan.
  10. Memastikan kelengkapan dan ketertiban dokumen serta supporting transaksi accounting.
  11. Melakukan analisis data accounting dan memberikan insight atau rekomendasi atas permasalahan yang ditemukan.
  12. Mendukung perbaikan proses accounting untuk meningkatkan akurasi, efisiensi, dan efektivitas pekerjaan.
raw_requirements:
1. Pendidikan minimal S1 Akuntansi, Keuangan, atau bidang terkait.
  2. Memiliki pengalaman kerja 2 - 4 tahun di bidang Accounting.
  3. Memiliki pemahaman yang baik mengenai PSAK, financial reporting, dan proses month-end/year-end closing.
  4. Memahami proses General Ledger, AR, AP, bank reconciliation, prepaid/accrual, dan fixed asset.
  5. Memahami dasar accounting treatment dan revenue recognition menjadi nilai tambah.
  6. Memiliki kemampuan Microsoft Excel yang baik dan familiar dengan software atau sistem accounting.
  7. Memiliki kemampuan analisis yang baik, teliti, detail-oriented, dan mampu bekerja dengan target waktu.
  8. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan koordinasi yang baik dengan pihak internal maupun eksternal.
  9. Memiliki integritas, ketelitian, dan komitmen terhadap akurasi serta kerahasiaan data keuangan.

title: Product Analyst - AID
raw_description:
1. 1. Membuat rancangan pengembangan produk data, API dan/atau platform berdasarkan hasil riset produk, kebutuhan requestor, maupun analisis produk.
  2. Melakukan monitoring dan koordinasi terhadap progres pengembangan produk, termasuk pelaksanaan pengujian (testing) untuk memastikan produk sesuai dengan kebutuhan dan spesifikasi yang telah ditetapkan.
  3. Melakukan monitoring terhadap penggunaan, performa, dan efisiensi produk data maupun API; menganalisis hasilnya; serta menyusun dan menindaklanjuti rencana improvement secara berkelanjutan.
  4. Mengumpulkan, mendokumentasikan, dan memelihara informasi produk data dan API yang telah dikembangkan untuk penyusunan katalog produk, serta melakukan sosialisasi kepada pihak terkait.
  5. Melakukan tindak lanjut dan koordinasi penyelesaian apabila pengguna produk mengalami kendala, isu, atau permasalahan terkait penggunaan produk, termasuk bekerja sama dengan tim teknis terkait.
raw_requirements:
1. Memiliki pengalaman kerja 1-3 tahun di bidang product management.
  2. Memiliki pemahaman yang baik mengenai industri digital, khususnya terkait data, platform, dan API.
  3. Memiliki kemampuan project management, termasuk perencanaan, koordinasi, dan monitoring proyek.
  4. Memiliki pemahaman dasar mengenai Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
  5. Memiliki pemahaman dasar mengenai implementasi ISO 27001.
  6. Memiliki pemahaman dasar mengenai data management, termasuk data lifecycle, data quality, dan data governance.
  7. Penempatan kerja di Astra Integrasi Digital (AID).

title: Data Engineer - AID
raw_description:
1. Mengidentifikasi dan mendokumentasikan kebutuhan data dari bisnis dan para pemangku kepentingan (stakeholders).
  2. Membangun dan memelihara infrastruktur data serta data warehouse yang skalabel dan terotomatisasi.
  3. Melakukan ekstraksi, transformasi, dan pengelolaan dataset untuk memastikan kesiapan dan konsistensi data.
  4. Menetapkan dan mengelola aturan kualitas data, proses validasi, serta rekonsiliasi data.
  5. Memantau dan meningkatkan metrik kualitas data, termasuk akurasi dan kelengkapan data.
  6. Menyusun laporan kualitas data serta rekomendasi perbaikan untuk mendukung kebutuhan dan use case bisnis.
  7. Mengoptimalkan dan mengembangkan produk data guna mendukung kebutuhan operasional maupun analitis.
  8. Mengelola dokumentasi dan standardisasi proses data engineering serta tata kelola data (data governance).
  9. Mengevaluasi tools dan teknologi data untuk meningkatkan kinerja serta efisiensi biaya.
raw_requirements:
1. Pendidikan minimal S1 di bidang Teknologi Informasi, Statistika, Ilmu Komputer, atau bidang lain yang relevan.
  2. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 2 tahun di bidang Data Engineering, Data Management, atau bidang terkait.
  3. Menguasai SQL, tools integrasi data, serta lingkungan komputasi berbasis cloud (Cloud Environment).
  4. Memiliki pemahaman yang baik mengenai konsep Big Data dan Big Data Management Framework.
  5. Memiliki kemampuan analitis, berpikir kritis, dan pemecahan masalah yang baik.
  6. Memiliki pola pikir kreatif serta mampu mendukung pengembangan solusi berbasis data dan peningkatan proses bisnis.

Life at Grab

The role at a glance

Get to Know the Team

Join the Consumer Experience (CX) Engineering team - we work on a diverse set of consumer problems spanning across core experiences that power the UX navigation and transaction funnels, search and discovery of content and services, user lifecycle covering user growth, engagement and loyalty and the critical platform mission of mobile application developer experience. We are on an exciting mission to connect consumers to Grab's marketplace by allowing them to discover and engage with Grab's services and partners.

Get to Know the Role

You are a Senior Engineer who designs, builds, operates, and monitors secure, high-quality software systems. You will partner with technical and non-technical team members from product design through rollout, drive project momentum, and uplift the team through mentorship and process improvements.

You will report to Engineering Manager, and you will be based on-site in Jakarta.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

Design and write in RxJava and/or Kotlin.

Collaborate with mobile and backend engineers, designers, data scientists and product managers to build features

Participate in code and design reviews to maintain our high development standards

Brainstorm ideas, identify problems, propose and implement solutions geared towards scale and performance

Take full ownership of projects that are built to meet functional and non-functional requirements of our users and partners.

Design, implement, instrument and deploy highly performant and reusable Android components for operational excellence programs

Lead collaboration across teams and roles, to resolve ambiguous, multi dimensional business, legal, and product needs.

Participate in interview loops to help Grab continue hiring top industry talent

Provide technical guidance, mentorship and knowledge sharing to peers.

About bp 

bp operates at the heart of the global energy system, helping countries meet their energy needs and serving millions of customers every day. With world-class assets, technology, trading capability and partnerships, we deliver energy at scale today while investing with discipline in the energy transition. 


About early careers  

Early careers opportunities  

Your talent. Your skills. Your big ideas (and even bigger dreams). We know you have a lot to give.  So, we’ll make sure you get a lot in return. From next-level experiences to global impact. From inspiring teammates to exceptional support – we offer graduate and internship roles across multiple areas. 


Our engineering graduate programme   

As a graduate engineer, you won’t just learn the ropes – you’ll help build what’s next.  

Why work in engineering at bp? 

·       Work on complex engineering projects with global impact.  

·       Build solutions today that help power tomorrow’s world.  

·       Learn from experts who push you to be your best. 

·       Achieve professional accreditation. 


As an engineering graduate, you’ll complete two or three rotations designed to give you breadth of experience across your chosen business area while also supporting you to build technical depth.


You’ll make an impact across our business as you learn how to safely extract, process and transport resources the world relies on. You’ll also enjoy being part of a global network of people who share your passion for problem solving and invention.


Join us and you’ll get the support of a structured technical pathway and our training program, designed to help you grow both professionally and personally. In return, you'll bring your ideas, curiosity and ambition to real business challenges. Along the way, you'll be part of a supportive bp early careers community that will help you grow, succeed and make a meaningful impact from day one. 

 

Mechanical Engineer

Mechanical engineers support our operations around the world. They work for ensuring the correct selection, specification, and construction of mechanical equipment and systems, as part of building new facilities or modifying existing assets. They work also to develop maintenance strategy, monitoring equipment performance, and investigating operational difficulties. There are also roles working as a technical specialist advising operations on particular aspects of mechanical engineering.
raw_requirements:
About you  

As a bp graduate, you will have an interest and/or skill in delivering economic value back to a business, identifying solutions and strategies resulting in cost savings and a natural negotiation style. No matter where you work at bp, you’ll be valued, included, and respected. We’ll provide you with on-going support and we’ll reward you for the great work you do.  

To be eligible to apply to the graduate positions, you are:  

• Have willingness to learn, passion to excel and deliver results  

• Have recently graduated from Bachelors (S1) or Masters (S2) or Doctoral (S3) program or will be graduating by August/November 2027

• Applicants with less than 2 years professional working experience may also apply 

• You should have completed or will complete your degree in mechanical engineering.

 

Location

title: Prime Natuna EP - Fixed Infrastructure Sr. Technical Safety Engineer
raw_description:
Responsible for Designing Technical Safety system for Fixed Infrastructure Project and ensure its safe and optimum project delivery as well as reliable operation.

Required to be mobilized to support the execution of Fixed Infrastructure FEED work, which is planned to commence in Oct’26. Involvement of a Sr. Technical Safety Engineer is critical to ensure readiness of Technical Safety Engineering Activities, including Safety Design Requirements, Major Accident Hazard assessment, SECE requirements, and required Process Safety Studies. Timely mobilization will ensure that Safety-Critical requirements are properly incorporated into the design from the early stage of FEED, while minimizing the risks of design gaps, late safety-driven changes, and rework during FEED and subsequent EPCI phases.

Areas of Accountability, Responsibility and Competence: 

  • ​​Deliver Technical Safety deliverables for Fixed Infrastructure scope.  
  • ​Establishing the Implementation of INBU HSE Technical Safety Program through an effective approach, 
  • ​Empowering the Mandatory Control Framework of MAH concept and stimulus the Technical Safety Performance Evaluation and identify Gaps, 
  • ​Strategically for evaluating the process for managing of MAH risks of the INBU, 
  • ​Hosting the Technical Safety Corporate and Regulatory requirements with aligned to Management direction and requirements 
  • ​Ensuring the technical healthiness and integrity of the SECEs. 
  • ​Delivering the Compliance process of SECE Verification Scheme process into Operation and Development Department 
  • ​Accountable for Validating to all Critical Process Safety Information at all Worksites 
  • ​Assuring to Deliver the analysis of Technical Safety Findings and Interventions which covering the aspects of Identify Root Causes, Formulate Intervention Strategies and Review intervention plans to strengthen HSE Control of Work. 
  • ​Providing the Technical Safety (HSE Engineering) Guidance with Innovative Technical Solutions in supporting the implementation of Technical Safety requirements at all Worksites 
  • ​Role Model for Process Safety and Coach for Process Safety Rules Implementation 
  • ​Supporting the Role and Responsibility of Technical Safety Technical Authority 
  • ​Coordinating to all Process Safety Programes 
  • ​Build, Train and Coach the Process Safety awareness especially to Operation and Development Personnel.
raw_requirements:
Qualification / Work Experience:

•Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, preferably in Chemical Process, Mechanical, Safety Engineering or other relevant Engineering discipline. 

• Minimum 15 years of experience in Technical / Process Safety Engineering within the Oil & Gas Industry, with strong exposure to Offshore Fixed Infrastructure Projects, preferably covering Project Development, FEED, and EPCI Phases.

• Proven experience in Technical Safety Engineering and Design for Offshore Facilities, including Development and review of Safety Engineering deliverables throughout the Project Lifecycle.

• Relevant Experience in Process Safety and Major Accident Hazard (MAH) Management, including Participation in Risk Assessments and Technical Safety Assurance Activities for Offshore facilities.

• Experience in supporting Construction, Pre-Commissioning, and Start-Up Activities associated with Technical Safety Systems is preferred.

• Fluent in English, Both written and Spoken, with proficiency in MS Office and relevant Technical Safety Engineering Tools/Software.

 

Special Skills:

'• In-depth expertise in Technical Safety Engineering and design for Offshore Fixed Infrastructure, including Development and Review of Safety Philosophies, Safety System Requirements, and Technical Safety deliverables.

• Strong capability in Process Safety and Major Accident Hazard (MAH) Management, including Identification, Assessment, and Mitigation of Major accident Risks throughout the Project Lifecycle.

• Strong knowledge of Safety and Environmental Critical Elements (SECEs), Safety Case requirements, and Verification Schemes, ensuring Technical Integrity and Compliance with Project and regulatory requirements.

• Proven capability in facilitating and supporting technical safety studies and risk assessments, including HAZID, HAZOP and other applicable process safety reviews, with effective follow-up and Close-out of Findings and Recommendations.

• Comprehensive knowledge of applicable Technical/Process Safety Codes, Standards, Regulatory Requirements, and Industry Best Practices, with the ability to provide Technical Safety assurance throughout Design, Construction, Pre-Commissioning, and Start-Up.
